newsitem.title: FINLAND: Tieto sees sales growth near longterm goal.
newsitem.headline: Tieto sees sales growth near longterm goal.

text.p: Finnish data systems group TT Tieto said on Tuesday the impact of acquisitions on its sales growth would even out in the second quarter and sales growth should largely reach its 15 percent longterm target.

It also said the overall outlook was bright and that there were chances for continued positive performance, although information technology companies' growth was increasingly hampered by a shortage of highly skilled professionals.

"The impact of acquisitions during 1996 on Tieto's net sales will even out further during the second quarter and, if no further acquisitions take place, consolidated net sales should largely reach the 15 percent longterm growth target," Tieto said in a statement with its first quarter earnings.
"The overall outlook is bright and conditions exist for continued positive performance," it added.
Tieto reported first quarter profit before extraordinary items at 60.4 million markka, up from 41.8 million in the year-ago period.
The median of analysts forecasts for the first quarter profit was 56 million markka and the highest forecast was 61 million markka.
Tieto's 1996 profit before extraordinary items was 194 million markka.
